routing.task_class: Explicitly selected CAO durable state control for native Codex coding work
routing.primary_route: Bind the explicit objective and exact root thread into .CAO before material work; rehydrate matching roots and descendants through official Hooks; reconcile native thread ancestry and collaboration facts through official app-server readback; record semantic work, decisions, progress, evidence, finalization, and handoff without owning execution topology.
fallback_conditions: If exact Hook or app-server ancestry is unavailable, record the event as unresolved, inject no state into that event, preserve .CAO, and stop finalization until reconciliation succeeds.
non_use_conditions: Do not activate from plugin inspection, generic coding, generic subagent use, incidental CAO text, or .CAO presence alone.
Do not use CAO as a worker launcher, model router, hierarchy manager, or acceptance substitute.

trigger_phrases: CAOでこの実装を状態管制して
aliases: コーディング・エージェント・オーケストレーター

interface.short_description: Durable CAO state control for native Codex work
interface.default_prompt: Use $coding-agent-orchestrator to bind this coding task to exact .CAO state while native Codex chooses the execution topology.

inputs.name: Explicit coding objective
inputs.description: The requested result, workspace, scope, instructions, authority boundary, and acceptance conditions.

inputs.name: Exact root thread binding
inputs.description: The current Codex root thread ID used to isolate active state from unrelated sessions.

inputs.name: Current durable state
inputs.description: Task facts, known work, decisions, progress, evidence, unresolved boundaries, runtime observations, and handoff under .CAO.

outputs.name: State-controlled coding result
outputs.description: The native Codex result integrated against the exact durable task contract.

outputs.name: Runtime observation ledger
outputs.description: Idempotent Hook and app-server facts for the bound root tree, excluding raw prompts and assistant messages.

outputs.name: Finalized workflow state
outputs.description: Closed semantic work, typed evidence coverage, finalization, and safe continuation state.

workflow_contract.runtime_observation_rule: Official SessionStart, SubagentStart, SubagentStop, and Stop Hooks provide immediate events; official app-server thread/read and thread/list data reconcile exact ancestry and collaboration facts.
workflow_contract.semantic_completion_rule: Runtime completion is never semantic completion. Only parent-integrated work results and the admitted acceptance evidence can close semantic state.
workflow_contract.state_rule: .CAO is the exact-root-bound state SSOT; .coding-agents is migration input only.
workflow_contract.acceptance_rule: Use one admitted task-sized acceptance bundle, finalize exact state, run doctor, and stop verification on success.
